newsitem.title: USA: US Stockpile loans Mint 81,000 ounces platinum.
newsitem.headline: US Stockpile loans Mint 81,000 ounces platinum.

text.p: U.S. Defense Stockpile said Friday it had loaned 81,000 troy ounces of platinum to the U.S. Mint for use in the Mint's new platinum coin issue.

"The terms of the agreement between the Mint and the Stockpile involve a loan of 81,000 troy ounces of 99.95 pct Stockpile platinum to the Mint," Richard Connelly, administrator of Defense Logistics Agency's Defense National Stockpile Center, said in a statement.
The Mint will return a like amount of similar quality platinum before the agreement expires in 2003, he said.
"If the occasion should arise, the Stockpile has the right to require the return of its platinum upon 30 days notice," Connelly said.

The actual transfer of the platinum will begin Friday and involves moving the metal from Stockpile Center vaults in the Treasury depository at West Point, N.Y., and delivering it to the Mint, he said.
This week the Mint began marketing its first-ever bullion platinum coin issue.
